Here are some custom items! These are some low-level items. I might make more low level ones, but I plan to move on to higher-level items in a little while. I hope they are useful/of interest. I (mostly) relied on [https://wow.allakhazam.com/wiki/Itemiza ... ulas_(WoW)](https://wow.allakhazam.com/wiki/Itemization_Formulas_%28WoW%29) to budget stats (I also just looked at items of similar level/ilvl). There are a couple comments I have on some items that I'll attach to them.
Belt of the Earth: [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Assassin's Crossbow: [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... wiTlVMTCJd](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Rogue's Gamble: [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Cold-Charged Gauntlets:[https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Note: I was hoping for this to be an instant-cast rank 1 Frostbolt (with 15 minute cd). I'm not sure I achieved that effect.
Fallen Farmer's Boots: [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... wiTlVMTCJd](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Heart-Shaped Locket: [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Hardwood Spaulders: [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Greatstaff of Conjuring: [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Note: I was thinking this could be a craftable from the enchanting profession. It would require the old Staff of Conjuring + maybe a pearl or something (in addition to some typical enchanting mats).
Brawler's Chainmail: [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Bands of the Hearth: [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Steadfast Gauntlets: [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Note: there are no low-value +block value spells (other than +1 block value). If there were, e.g., a +4-5 block value spell, I would rework these to include that spell + more armor (and perhaps + a small amount of stamina).
Flame Priest's Robes: [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
I hope these are useful. If there are any issues with them let me know and I can fix it. And I'd be happy to hear any feedback - positive or negative!

There are a couple comments I have on some items that I'll attach to them.
>
>  I hope these are useful. If there are any issues with them let me know and I can fix it. And I'd be happy to hear any feedback - positive or negative!
>  (Edits due to item updates.)

So interesting. I love looking at these and imagining them. I do like it when a piece of gear and it's ability to enhance abilities (via stats) makes good sense. A lot of those are cool.

One thing I look at it the Rogue's Gambit (bracers).  Why would they enhance agility at the cost of stamina. I dig the 'gambit' piece, but when I think agility I think of capacity to move more freely/adroitly (which is maybe best exemplified conceptually by a rogue). So in that vein, I think Legs or a Tunic would be good for a +AGI, -STA stat set.

Just a thought. I would dig a piece like that that makes me decide between things. Not enough of that at all in this game.

## Post 10274 by Merikkinon (Patch Note Conspiracy Theorist) — 2021-04-28T02:52:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=10274#p10274 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

I think the Greatstaff of Conjuring (any conjuring staff or item - and they are cool) needs to be for magic-wielding classes - priests, mages, druids, shaman, warlocks.  It mentions 'mages' in the tooltip, but why would a mage need a staff for conjuring water?  It would be very cool for a non-mage magic user, however. And very in line with magic 'lore'.

## Post 10276 by Gnarbrok — 2021-04-28T03:34:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=10276#p10276 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

Thanks for the feedback! For the Rogue's Gamble bracers, I wasn't thinking so much about why they might reduce stamina, but I'll try to think of something. But, as the name suggests, equipping the bracers is supposed to be a "gamble" since you are lowering your HP for a chance at doing more damage.
As for the staff, the tooltip is just funky. The spell the staff allows you to cast is a mage spell, "Conjure Water". So it mentions the mage class in the tooltip. (I believe the original Staff of Conjuring also creates mage food.)

## Post 10310 by Gnarbrok — 2021-04-30T12:28:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=10310#p10310 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

I've moved on to level 20-30 items. There is a bit more room for new items here (since there is a bit more flexibility in stat budgeting) so I've decided to start with cloth armor, and I'll go through leather and mail afterwards, then I'll make weapons, and then I'll add in a smattering of grey and white items. Here's what I have for cloth:
Dark Acolyte's Robes: [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Student's Enchanted Gloves: [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Note: I found this effect, "Wand Power", by chance and thought it would be interesting to put on an item - I'm not even sure where this is used in the game. If it was spell crit chance, this would be way over budget (and there is no 1% version), but it seems acceptable as just wand crit chance (and perhaps even underwhelming, although priests would love it).
Novice Wizard's Hat: [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... wiTlVMTCJd](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Fitted Shoes: [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Leggings of Peace: [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Note: mp5 is weighted *really* heavily.
Medic's Mantle: [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Winter Expedition Bracers: [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... 5VTEwiXQ==](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
Hip Flask Belt: [https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!/itemcreat ... JOVUxMIl0=](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
